cohort: 311 mothers from Australia and New Zealand.
finding: Maternal enjoyment/role-attainment was associated with increased odds of breastfeeding to 6 and 12 months, while post-traumatic stress symptoms were associated with decreased odds.
mod_finding: Although caesarean birth was associated with reduced rates of breastfeeding at 6 and 12 months in unadjusted analyses, it was associated with a three-fold increase in odds of breastfeeding beyond 6 months to 12 months (OR=3.03) after psychological variables were accounted for.
